control: Isolation tests, least privilege, scoped retrieval
trigger: Any suspected disclosure: contain and invoke incident plan
Revocation cannot be confirmed: deny access; escalate recovery

Wrong audience: revoke access and investigate
Parallel authority model: stop and reconcile
